summary: Represents a chore for a Duplicant to perform data raining, a recreational activity involving spawning databanks. This chore uses a state machine to manage its different phases (idle, moving to a social gathering point, and raining data).  It prioritizes based on `RELAXATION.PRIORITY.TIER1` and requires the Duplicant to be available during scheduled recreation time and not during a red alert.

keyMethods.name: DataRainerChore(IStateMachineTarget target)
keyMethods.description: Constructor. Initializes the chore with the target GameObject, sets preconditions (not red alert, scheduled recreation time, and worker prioritization check), and creates the state machine instance.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The GameObject that this chore is associated with (likely a DataRainer building).

keyMethods.name: GetWorkerPriority(WorkerBase worker, out int priority)
keyMethods.description: Gets the priority of this chore for a given worker.  Returns the base priority (`RELAXATION.PRIORITY.TIER1`).

keyMethods.name: States.InitializeStates(out StateMachine.BaseState default_state)
keyMethods.description: Initializes the states of the internal state machine. Defines transitions between idle, moving to a data rainer, and the raining animation. Spawns 'PowerStationTools' prefabs as databanks during the raining phase.  Uses animation controllers and manages the databank spawn interval.

parameters.name: default_state
parameters.description: The default state of the state machine.

keyMethods.name: StatesInstance.IsRecTime()
keyMethods.description: Checks if the current game time is within the scheduled recreation time.

return.description: True if it's recreation time, false otherwise.

keyMethods.name: StatesInstance.GetTargetCell()
keyMethods.description: Finds the closest available SocialGatheringPoint to the Duplicant. If none is found, uses the DataRainer's cell as the target.

return.description: The grid cell of the target location.

keyProperties.name: basePriority
keyProperties.description: The base priority level of this chore, set to `RELAXATION.PRIORITY.TIER1` (a constant representing a priority level).

keyProperties.name: showAvailabilityInHoverText
keyProperties.description: Flag indicating whether chore availability should be shown in the hover text. Set to false.

keyProperties.name: States.dataRainer
keyProperties.description: State machine parameter representing the DataRainer GameObject.

keyProperties.name: States.nextBankTimer
keyProperties.description: State machine parameter representing a timer for spawning databanks. Initialized with half of `DataRainer.databankSpawnInterval`.

keyProperties.name: StatesInstance.dataRainer
keyProperties.description: Reference to the DataRainer GameObject within the state machine instance.
